title: Cassius asks for help

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: Oh I'm glad we've run into each other again.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh I'm glad we've run into each other again.

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: Thanks for your help last time. I was wondering if I could ask you some questions?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks for your help last time. I was wondering if I could ask you some questions?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Oh hey.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh hey.

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: Wow. Ok. I'm going to choose to ignore that. As I might need your help.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wow. Ok. I'm going to choose to ignore that. As I might need your help.

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: No no no, I finally worked all that out. Thankfully. No I need help with something a little more... sensitive.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No no no, I finally worked all that out. Thankfully. No I need help with something a little more... sensitive.

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: I'm fairly safe in the assumption that you are in fact, a poor person?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm fairly safe in the assumption that you are in fact, a poor person?

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: No no no I do not wish to offend. I mean for some, you are in an enviable position!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No no no I do not wish to offend. I mean for some, you are in an enviable position!

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: Well I hope I have not caused any offense, because, for some, you are in a very enviable position.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well I hope I have not caused any offense, because, for some, you are in a very enviable position.

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: Some of those more affluent members of society like to roleplay as... well some of the less affluent members of society.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Some of those more affluent members of society like to roleplay as... well some of the less affluent members of society.

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: I mean, it has a few more subtleties than that but broadly speaking, yes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I mean, it has a few more subtleties than that but broadly speaking, yes.

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: Look, I'm not saying I agree with it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look, I'm not saying I agree with it.

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: Me? No! God no, absolutely cannot think of anything worse.... sorry, I just mean... look, there's a possibility that, my parents, might have got into the lifestyle, and now... nobody can find them.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Me? No! God no, absolutely cannot think of anything worse.... sorry, I just mean... look, there's a possibility that, my parents, might have got into the lifestyle, and now... nobody can find them.

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: Hey now... keep the voice down there champ. Too early to say if they're missing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey now... keep the voice down there champ. Too early to say if they're missing.

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: Eighteen months... give or take.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Eighteen months... give or take.

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: I've been in space!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I've been in space!

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: Look, I need someone with boots on the ground. Someone in the Spire suggested Thaddeus but that lead me to you. Think you could sniff around? I know nothing about running hotels. The company could collapse.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look, I need someone with boots on the ground. Someone in the Spire suggested Thaddeus but that lead me to you. Think you could sniff around? I know nothing about running hotels. The company could collapse.

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: So you want to see me beg? Because I will. Do not think I'm above it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So you want to see me beg? Because I will. Do not think I'm above it.

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: That's a good sport!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's a good sport!

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: I knew you were the real-deal!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I knew you were the real-deal!

nodes.speaker: Cassius Pierrepont IV
nodes.text: Well it might sound a little odd but there is a new fad among those living in the Spire.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well it might sound a little odd but there is a new fad among those living in the Spire.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Me too!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Me too!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That makes one of us.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That makes one of us.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Is it a toilet thing again?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Is it a toilet thing again?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Is it a toilet thing again?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Is it a toilet thing again?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Intriguing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Intriguing.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Make it quick.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Make it quick.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Hey, that's none of your business!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey, that's none of your business!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Hey, that's none of your business!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Hey, that's none of your business!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I mean... I guess.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I mean... I guess.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Enviable? How so?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Enviable? How so?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Odd? It sounds barbaric!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Odd? It sounds barbaric!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Pretending to be poor?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Pretending to be poor?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do you want pointers on being poor Cassius?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you want pointers on being poor Cassius?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Do you want pointers on being poor Cassius?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Do you want pointers on being poor Cassius?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: They're missing?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: They're missing?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How long have they been pov-playing?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How long have they been pov-playing?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: How long have they been pov-playing?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: How long have they been pov-playing?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Eighteen Months?!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Eighteen Months?!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So now what?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So now what?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: This sounds like a rich person problem.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This sounds like a rich person problem.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: This sounds like a rich person problem.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: This sounds like a rich person problem.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I guess I could ask around.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I guess I could ask around.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I guess I could ask around.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I guess I could ask around.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Fine! I'll keep an eye out.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fine! I'll keep an eye out.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Fine! I'll keep an eye out.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Fine! I'll keep an eye out.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Tell me!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Tell me!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Oh, interesting!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, interesting!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So it's only been a couple days, good.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So it's only been a couple days, good.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So it's only been a couple days, good.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So it's only been a couple days, good.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why are you only looking for them now?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why are you only looking for them now?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why are you only looking for them now?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why are you only looking for them now?
